sourceText:
Watermelon Delight
By: Usha Chowdhary Gupta
Published: Thursday, October 21, 2010 - 7:07am

Ingredients




WATERMELON DELIGHT
1 tablespoon  Rose Syrup
1 cup Tender Coconut Water
1 cup Watermelon Cut into Pieces
3 tablespoons Vanilla Ice cream
3 tablespoons Crushed Ice
1 tablespoon Very Small Pieces Of Watermelon

Preparation

1 METHOD: In a mixer jar put all ingredients 2 Except the small cut pieces of watermelon for garnish. 3 Churn and pour the drink in a tall glass and serve with 4 The pieces of watermelon on top. 5 OR 6 With the same above mentioned ingredients, make another lovely mocktail. In a mixer jar take the cut pieces of watermelon, make juice out of it. Now take a tall glass, at the bottom pour the rose syrup & the crushed ice . On this pour the watermelon juice, on it tender coconut water. 7 Top it with some ice cream and the small pieces of watermelon pieces.
